semiconductor_relevance: High — CN1 Co., Ltd specializes in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) systems, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CN1 Co., Ltd is a leader in the development and innovation of Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) equipment, catering to the semiconductor, display, and nanotechnology sectors. Their ALD systems are utilized by numerous universities and enterprises globally, ensuring high-quality deposition processes essential for advanced semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Japan: CN1 has a presence in Japan, providing ALD systems to local enterprises.
regional_presence.Singapore: CN1's ALD technology is utilized in Singapore's semiconductor industry.
regional_presence.Taiwan: CN1 supplies ALD systems to Taiwan, a key player in semiconductor manufacturing.
